Endocrinology & Diabetes Care at Silver Touch Hospitals

Diabetes management is more than maintaining sugar levels. It requires comprehension of how hormones influence your body, and that’s where professional endocrine care is needed. At Silver Touch Hospitals, our team of experienced endocrinologists and diabetes experts provide individualised, ongoing care to assist patients in living more balanced, healthier lives.

From early diagnosis to sophisticated diabetes management strategies, we accompany you through every phase of the way. From being newly diagnosed to dealing with uncontrolled blood sugar levels, we want to assist you in taking control, reducing complications, and enhancing your quality of life. So, if you are seeking a diabetes specialist near Prahladnagar, visit one of our hospitals.

Why Silver Touch Hospitals?

Being one of the most reliable diabetes hospital in Ahmedabad, Silver Touch Hospitals offers complete care for every form of diabetes, including Type 1, Type 2, gestational diabetes, and other complicated endocrine disorders. We are also dealing with hormonal disorders like thyroid imbalance, PCOS, adrenal disorders, and pituitary gland disorders.

Our treatment protocols are evidence-based, and we integrate medication, lifestyle counselling, and monitoring. We also collaborate with other specialists as per need and nutritional teams to provide coordinated, multidisciplinary care.

What Services Do We Offer?

  • Blood glucose monitoring and HbA1c tests
  • Insulin regimen planning and titration
  • Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) therapy assistance
  • Type 1 diabetes care
  • Diabetes education and nutrition counselling
  • Treatment of thyroid disorders
  • Hormonal disorder screening and treatment

We trust in education and regular follow-up of patients for empowering them, so they remain aware and active in care.

Skilled Endocrinologists and Experts

Our senior staff consists of well-trained experts with several years of experience in clinical practice. In case you are searching for a skilled endocrinologist for diabetes in Ahmedabad, you can be certain that Silver Touch Hospitals will provide ethical, modern, and caring treatment.

We also provide accessible services for patients living or working nearby. If you’re trying to find a diabetes specialist near Prahladnagar, our Satellite branch is conveniently located with easy appointment options.

Book an Appointment

Don’t let uncontrolled diabetes impact your life. Early treatment and regular reviews can make a lasting difference. Call us today or book your consultation with a leading diabetes specialist in Ahmedabad.

faqs.q: When can I meet a diabetes specialist?
faqs.a: If you have been diagnosed with diabetes or are showing symptoms such as increased thirst, excessive urination, fatigue, or unexpected loss of weight, you would do well to consult a specialist. They will provide you with a tailor-made treatment plan and keep track of your condition in the long term.

faqs.q: Do I need a referral to visit Silver Touch Hospitals?
faqs.a: No. You can book an appointment for a consultation directly from our helpline or website without any referral.

faqs.q: Do Silver Touch Hospitals offer diet support for diabetes?
faqs.a: Yes. Our treatment for diabetes includes trained nutritionists as part of the care team, who will walk you through simple, achievable meal plans designed specifically for your condition.

faqs.q: Are follow-ups and monitoring part of the treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide formal follow-up timelines, lab checkups, and sugar monitoring to monitor progress and modify treatment appropriately.
